_comment: Per-solution metadata used by generate.py to build standardized header blocks and the README index. 'url' / 'name' / 'topic' set to null mean the real HackerRank problem could not be reliably identified from an ordinal filename; the generator emits a TODO marker for those fields. Fill them in when confirmed. Difficulty is 'Easy' for everything currently under the easy/ folders.

cpp/easy/first_problem.cpp.name: Say "Hello, World!" With C++
cpp/easy/first_problem.cpp.approach: Print the required string to stdout.

cpp/easy/second_problem.cpp.name: Input and Output
cpp/easy/second_problem.cpp.approach: Read three integers and print their sum.

cpp/easy/third_problem.cpp.name: Basic Data Types
cpp/easy/third_problem.cpp.approach: Read int, long, char, float, double and print each with the required precision.

cpp/easy/forth_problem.cpp.name: Conditional Statements (number to word, n <= 9)
cpp/easy/forth_problem.cpp.approach: Map 1..9 to its English word, otherwise print 'Greater than 9'. Uses a custom ltrim/rtrim to clean the input line.

cpp/easy/fifth_problem.cpp.name: For Loop
cpp/easy/fifth_problem.cpp.approach: Iterate from a to b; print the word for 1..9, otherwise 'even'/'odd'.

cpp/easy/seventh_problem.cpp.name: Pointers
cpp/easy/seventh_problem.cpp.approach: Via pointers, set *a to the sum and *b to the absolute difference.

cpp/easy/eighth_problem.cpp.name: Arrays Introduction
cpp/easy/eighth_problem.cpp.approach: Read n integers and print them in reverse order.

cpp/easy/ninth_problem.cpp.name: Variable Sized Arrays
cpp/easy/ninth_problem.cpp.approach: Store a jagged 2D vector, then answer (i, j) index queries in O(1) each.

cpp/easy/tenth_problem.cpp.name: StringStream
cpp/easy/tenth_problem.cpp.approach: Parse a comma-separated list of ints with a stringstream, discarding commas.

cpp/easy/eleventh_problem.cpp.name: Strings
cpp/easy/eleventh_problem.cpp.approach: Print both lengths, the concatenation, then swap the first characters and reprint.

cpp/easy/twelfth_problem.cpp.name: Structs
cpp/easy/twelfth_problem.cpp.approach: Read a Student struct's fields and print them back.

cpp/easy/thirteenth_problem.cpp.name: Class
cpp/easy/thirteenth_problem.cpp.approach: Encapsulate Student fields behind getters/setters plus a to_string() helper.

cpp/easy/fourteenth_problem.cpp.name: Classes and Objects
cpp/easy/fourteenth_problem.cpp.approach: Build n Student objects, total each one's five scores, and count how many beat student 0 (Kristen).

cpp/easy/fifteenth_problem.cpp.name: Box It!
cpp/easy/fifteenth_problem.cpp.approach: A Box class with constructors, a copy constructor, volume, operator< and operator<< handling the five query types.

cpp/easy/sixteenth_problem.cpp.name: Vector-Sort
cpp/easy/sixteenth_problem.cpp.approach: Read into a vector and std::sort ascending.

cpp/easy/seventeenth_problem.cpp.name: Vector-Erase
cpp/easy/seventeenth_problem.cpp.approach: Erase a single 1-based index, then erase a [a, b) range, then print the remaining size and elements.

cpp/easy/eighteenth_problem.cpp.name: Lower Bound-STL
cpp/easy/eighteenth_problem.cpp.approach: For each query, binary_search for presence and lower_bound for the 1-based position.

cpp/easy/nineteenth_problem.cpp.name: Sets-STL
cpp/easy/nineteenth_problem.cpp.approach: Maintain a std::set under insert / erase / find queries.

cpp/easy/twentieth_problem.cpp.name: Maps-STL
cpp/easy/twentieth_problem.cpp.approach: Maintain a std::map<string,int> under add / delete / query operations.

cpp/easy/twentyfirst_problem.cpp.name: Inheritance Introduction
cpp/easy/twentyfirst_problem.cpp.approach: Add a description() method to an Isosceles class that derives from Triangle.

cpp/easy/twentysecond_problem.cpp.name: Rectangle Area
cpp/easy/twentysecond_problem.cpp.approach: RectangleArea derives from Rectangle, reads dimensions, and overrides display() to print the area.

cpp/easy/twentythird_problem.cpp.name: Multi Level Inheritance
cpp/easy/twentythird_problem.cpp.approach: Equilateral derives from Isosceles derives from Triangle; add equilateral().

java/easy/first_problem.java.name: Welcome to Java! / Java Stdin and Stdout I
java/easy/first_problem.java.approach: Print the two required greeting lines. (Ordinal filename; exact challenge slug unconfirmed.)

java/easy/second_problem.java.name: Java Stdin and Stdout I
java/easy/second_problem.java.approach: Read three integers from stdin and echo them on separate lines.

java/easy/third_problem.java.name: Java If-Else
java/easy/third_problem.java.approach: Classify n as Weird/Not Weird per the odd/even and range rules.

java/easy/fourth_problem.java.name: Java Stdin and Stdout II
java/easy/fourth_problem.java.approach: Read an int, a double and a string and print them in the required order.

java/easy/fifth_problem.java.name: Java Output Formatting
java/easy/fifth_problem.java.approach: Use printf with %-14s and %03d to left-pad strings and zero-pad numbers.

java/easy/sixth_problem.java.name: Java Loops II (multiplication table)
java/easy/sixth_problem.java.approach: Print the multiplication table of N from 1 to 10. (Ordinal filename; exact challenge slug unconfirmed.)

java/easy/seventh_problem.java.name: Java Loops
java/easy/seventh_problem.java.approach: For each query print a, a+2^0*b, a+(2^0+2^1)*b, ... building the series incrementally.
